xyz-probe-reach-mm.description: PGFUN XYZ probe nominal new stylus length, seating shoulder to ball bottom; editable reach default requested by the operator.

scripts.description: Position the tool above the setter. Searches downward at 800 mm/min, backs off until released at 50 mm/min, then re-touches at 50 mm/min. Saves both contacts and stops after the slow touch. Z only; travel starts at the position when Run is pressed.

Start clear above the block. Discovers its rotated footprint on a 1 mm grid, then double-touches the same side stations on three circuits 1 mm apart. Unexpected outside-edge Z contact retracts above the measured top and cancels. X: physical RIGHT / LinuxCNC -X; physical LEFT / LinuxCNC +X.
Start clear inside the hole at probing height. XY only. X: physical RIGHT / LinuxCNC -X; physical LEFT / LinuxCNC +X.
Offsets start at the current XY. X positive: physical LEFT / LinuxCNC +X; X negative: physical RIGHT / LinuxCNC -X. Probe reach defaults to the configured PGFUN stylus specification and is editable.

Start clear above the stock. Growing contact/miss brackets guide a connected top grid without assuming a rectangle. Cell-centre checks sample between grid contacts; detected gaps are refined. Each dip returns to starting Z; descent stays inside the entered budget. Plate-censored and unsampled areas remain unknown. Uses the shared mapper feed settings and nominal editable probe reach. X: physical RIGHT / LinuxCNC -X; physical LEFT / LinuxCNC +X.

Start clear above the block. The first-edge search doubles its distance from the starting sample, then refines the contact/miss bracket. At Trace depth below the last top contact, local search intervals grow and measured midpoints refine the outline. Initial / minimum trace interval limits how small that search becomes; Outline resolution sets midpoint disagreement and seam tolerance. Intervals that reach minimum spacing remain marked unresolved. Each contact gets a full probe-diameter backoff; refinement retraces retained clear paths. Plate bounds limit every candidate. First search: physical RIGHT / LinuxCNC -X. Local tracing: physical RIGHT / LinuxCNC -X; physical LEFT / LinuxCNC +X.

parameters.label: Trace depth below last top contact
